classification: measure with declared conditional model and exact finite enumeration
statement: For all L selected sources under a shared activation of probability f, active outputs equal one named wrong value. Otherwise source errors are jointly independent conditional on truth with rate e, uniform among n-1 wrong labels. Then U_L=f+(1-f)*((1-e)^L+e^L/(n-1)^(L-1)), and wrong unanimity W_L=f+(1-f)*e^L/(n-1)^(L-1).
hypotheses: n>=2, L>=1, declared f and e, fixed truth for wrong-label enumeration; symmetry permits uniform truth extension.
Activation affects every selected source, no other unmodeled activation or observation channel.
Joint conditional independence is a model declaration for inactive draws, not inferred from pairwise statistics.
If n>2 and 0<e<=1, or n=2 and 0<e<1, both private unanimity terms tend to zero, giving limit f; finite values generally exceed f.
existing: U_L is exactly the published fitUnanimityModel single-dominant-factor curve, not a new algebraic law or identification method.
adds: Explicit equivalence of scheduled coordinated outputs and a shared-cause output distribution under this specified mixture, exact small-L enumeration, wrong-unanimity distinction and named invalid readings.
nonIdentification: The activation schedule is itself a common variable in the joint distribution. No inference about a shared physical process, intent or causal origin follows from the same curve; c_total is a compatible model parameter, not model-free truth.
negative: At e=0 all outputs are unanimously correct when inactive: U_L=1 for every L, so U does not identify f. W_L still equals f.
Two disjoint groups independently activated at rate f/2 do not obey the all-source single-activation curve with mass f.
Marginal error rate e without joint conditional independence does not determine private unanimity; n=2, e=1/2, identical private errors give U=1 while iid predicts 2^(1-L).
status: declared-model measure; finite vectors, no causal identification
unmeasured: Missing joint-independence declaration refuses curve interpretation by name; unknown mechanism remains unmeasured.
